mapper.select: SELECT id, version_number, title, body, created_at FROM knowledge_version WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND item_id = #{itemId} AND id = #{versionId}

SELECT l.item_id, l.topic_id FROM knowledge_item_topic l JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.id = l.item_id JOIN knowledge_topic t ON t.id = l.topic_id AND t.owner_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.owner_id = #{owner} AND l.item_id IN #{id} ORDER BY l.item_id, l.topic_id
SELECT id, name, color FROM knowledge_topic WHERE owner_id = #{owner} ORDER BY name, id LIMIT 201
SELECT id FROM knowledge_topic WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id IN #{id}
SELECT id, name, color FROM knowledge_topic WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND normalized_name = #{normalizedName}
SELECT id, source_id, target_id, relation_type FROM knowledge_relation WHERE owner_id = #{owner} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, source_id, target_id, relation_type FROM knowledge_relation WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND source_id = #{source} AND target_id = #{target} AND relation_type = #{type}

SELECT i.id, v.title, p.x, p.y FROM knowledge_item i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.id = i.current_version_id AND v.item_id = i.id AND v.owner_id = i.owner_id JOIN knowledge_position p ON p.item_id = i.id AND p.owner_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.owner_id = #{owner} AND i.kind = 'CONCEPT' AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY i.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT layout_revision FROM owner_workspace WHERE owner_id = #{owner}

SELECT i.id FROM knowledge_item i JOIN knowledge_position p ON p.item_id = i.id AND p.owner_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.owner_id = #{owner} AND i.kind = 'CONCEPT' AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_item (id, owner_id, kind, status, metadata_revision, current_version_id, version_number, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{owner}, #{kind}, 'ACTIVE', 0, NULL, 1, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO knowledge_version (id, item_id, owner_id, version_number, title, body, source_type, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{itemId}, #{owner}, #{number}, #{title}, #{body}, 'USER', #{now})
INSERT INTO knowledge_draft (item_id, title, body, revision, saved_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{body}, 0, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_item SET current_version_id = #{versionId} WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{owner} AND current_version_id IS NULL
UPDATE knowledge_item SET updated_at = #{now} WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id = #{id}
UPDATE knowledge_item SET metadata_revision = metadata_revision + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND metadata_revision = #{expectedRevision}
UPDATE knowledge_item SET status = #{status}, metadata_revision = metadata_revision + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id = #{id} AND metadata_revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.delete: DELETE l FROM knowledge_item_topic l JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.id = l.item_id WHERE i.owner_id = #{owner} AND i.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_topic (id, owner_id, name, normalized_name, color, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{owner}, #{name}, #{normalizedName}, #{color}, #{now})
INSERT INTO knowledge_relation (id, owner_id, source_id, target_id, relation_type, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{owner}, #{source}, #{target}, #{type}, #{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_relation WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_position (item_id, owner_id, x, y) VALUES (#{id}, #{owner}, #{x}, #{y})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_position SET x = #{x}, y = #{y} WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND item_id = #{id}
UPDATE owner_workspace SET layout_revision = layout_revision + 1 WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND layout_revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_outbox (owner_id, item_id, version_id, event_type, created_at, processed_at) VALUES (#{owner}, #{itemId}, #{versionId}, #{eventType}, #{now}, NULL)
